quality_check.description: A single vertical editorial ink-wash illustration on warm worn ivory paper. A large circular economic-style gauge with a restrained ochre rim dominates the center, with a red lipstick tube laid diagonally across the dial as the implied needle. Muted sage, teal, taupe and recession-gray wash segments sit within the gauge, a small gray storm cloud hangs at lower left, and a miniature shopping street runs beneath the gauge. Loose charcoal inset boundary marks, watercolor pooling, subdued shadows and controlled lipstick-red accents visibly continue the established editorial-page treatment.

prompt:
Edit

Create exactly one vertical 9:16 image: an isolated editorial ink-wash metaphor showing a lipstick tube acting like the needle of an old-fashioned economic gauge, poised within a restrained ochre gauge frame above a miniature shopping street, with a small recession-gray storm cloud hanging nearby. Use a slightly high-angle view and a compact circular composition; playful and quirky but visually restrained, suggesting an informal recession signal without implying scientific certainty. Render everything as warm, tactile editorial ink wash on lightly toothy cream-to-faded-ivory paper, with soft charcoal contours, brush variation, faint dry-brush pooling, restrained hatching, slight print wear and imperfect registration. Palette: muted taupe and recession-gray browns, dusty sage, desaturated teal, soft charcoal, restrained ochre, with lipstick-red reserved for the lipstick and tiny compositional echoes. Lighting is soft diffuse editorial daylight with warm paper glow and subdued shadows. Fill the complete illustration height naturally—no lower caption reserve, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail subtitle band. Reference roles: use the style_reference only for medium, linework, texture, palette and lighting; use the world_keyframe only to preserve the established recurring ivory editorial-page frame language and loose charcoal-and-ink inset boundary treatment; use the previous_beat as binding reference for recurring material/edge treatment, illustration-window treatment, texture, palette and lighting, but do not copy its composition, crop, camera angle, subject placement or focal object. No photorealism, glossy 3D, anime, neon, corporate vector art or hyper-saturated advertising. Exactly one image only—no storyboard, grid, collage, panels, captions, labels, numbers, letters, UI or any readable text.

Clarify the gauge mechanism
Strengthen the circular composition NON-NEGOTIABLE EPISODE FRAME CONTRACT: Preserve this recurring frame language in this image: a recurring warm ivory editorial page with lightly worn irregular paper edges, faint ink pooling, restrained print wear, and a consistent inset illustration window defined by loose charcoal-and-ink boundary marks; each body image should feel printed or washed onto the same tactile editorial sheet, with lipstick-red appearing only as a controlled recurring accent. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it. Do not reserve a lower caption field, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail band. Continue the scene and its natural texture through the full usable height, guided by the previous accepted image, without adding text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words or UI.
